query: May a California housing provider charge a pet deposit or extra rent for an assistance animal needed because of a disability?
expected_answer: No. A necessary assistance animal must be allowed as a reasonable accommodation without a pet deposit or extra rent, although a request may be denied if the animal creates a direct health or safety threat or substantial property damage.
